messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service: inference-api-frontend-5xx (severity: critical). alert_id=INC-2026-219 · triggered by healthcheck: 5xx_ratio > 0.10 for 2m. Notifying @jen (oncall) and escalation policy.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty page: inference-api-frontend-5xx -> @jen. Escalation: if not ack in 2m, escalate to @omar.

jen: acked. I'm on it. seeing a spike in 5xx across canary hosts in eu-west-1.

omar: on standby, ping me if we need traffic diversion. any customer-visible errors yet?

jen: initial sampling: retros from logs show `RuntimeError: KV cache mismatch` on embed route /v1/embeddings for a subset of requests. Error rate ~12% for canary pool, overall prod ~2.3% because stable pool okay.

leah: support: got 3 customer reports for failed chat completions in EU in last 10m. CS ticket numbers: #4571, #4572. I'll attach logs.

miguel: deployment-bot: Canary rollout v2.3.7 -> v2.3.8 started 5m ago. 10% traffic to canary. autoscaler/rolling-update timeline attached.

jen: hypothesis: new quant-kernel path in v2.3.8 triggers a rare codepath causing KV cache shape mismatch at sequence boundary. Only shows up when sequence lengths > 1024 and with continuous-batching on.

omar: ok. immediate actions: 1) Pause rollout 2) Divert canary traffic back to stable (20% reroute) 3) If diversion doesn't bring 5xx down within 2m, rollback canary 4) Notify customers and open incident bridge.

jen: paused rollout via `kubectl annotate deploy/inference-feature canary.pause=true` and verified controller respected it.

jen: rerouting 70% of canary traffic back to stable for the EU region using traffic-split tool:
```
traffic-split set inference-api --region eu-west-1 --canary 3 --stable 7
```

jen: after reroute: canary pool error rate dropped to 1.4% within 90s. overall prod 5xx back to 1.8%.

pagerduty-bot: Alert auto-escalation suppressed (incident acknowledged).

leah: customer impact: affected customers are using long-context embedding + chat workflows in EU. Estimate ~4-6% of EU requests saw failures for the 5min window after deploy. Raising communication to Tier 2 customers.

omar: good mitigation. what's plan for next steps? rollback or patch?

jen: short-term: roll forward traffic stabilization and keep canary paused. Create rollback PR as a safety net. Long-term: fix quant-kernel boundary check and add unit/integration tests for sequence >1024 and mixed-batch sizes.

miguel: created rollback PR #2310 that reverts v2.3.8 -> v2.3.7. CI green but not merging yet.

ops-sre: recommend merging rollback immediately if we see any regression reoccur on ramp. For now hold; monitor for 30m and collect traces.

jen: collecting traces and flamegraphs. attaching example trace ids: trace-0a1b2c, trace-0a1b2d showing kv mismatch in attention kernel. Also saved core dump from one canary instance.

leah: notifying affected customers via support template. Draft message: "We've paused the recent rollout after observing increased error rates for long-context requests in EU; we're reverting to stable behavior and will follow up with timeline." Want review before sending.

omar: send to Tier 1 now, wait for me to approve Tier 2 phrasing.

jen: monitoring dashboards: p50/p95 latency stable, p99 slight bump but 5xx back to baseline. Will keep canary at 3% (paused) and run additional tests against the canary binary in a mirrored staging environment.

paging: incident-bot: Bridge opened at https://meet.inc/INC-2026-219.

pagerduty-bot: Next escalation if not resolved/closed in 30m -> lead-sre.

miguel: note: no DB schema changes in this deploy. Root likely runtime-only. Patch ETA 2-3 hours after root cause triage.

jen: handoff plan: I'm keeping the bridge until 03:20 UTC; if still open I'll hand to the morning oncall (omar). Leaving runbook notes:
- paused canary (annotate)
- traffic-split set inference-api --region eu-west-1 --canary 3 --stable 7
- rollback PR #2310 exists (do not merge unless error returns)
- traces: trace-0a1b2c, trace-0a1b2d
- contacting customers: draft in #support-drafts

omar: acknowledged handoff. I'll standby and run the mirrored test pass in staging with high-length sequences. If we get a repeat, we'll merge rollback and escalate to oncall-lead.

leah: support: messages sent to affected customers (Tier1). CS will update if more hits arrive.

jen: marking incident as mitigated for now — still on bridge for monitoring and follow-ups. Will create postmortem template and assign to eng-ml.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-219 status: mitigated (customers still being notified). Follow-up: postmortem assigned to eng-ml, priority P1 review in 48h.

omar: thanks everyone. I'll take the bridge if it stays open after 03:20 UTC. Good triage, clear runbook.

leah: closing support loop for current CS tickets; will reopen if new reports come in. :thumbsup:

jen: closing thread updates here — will file postmortem link when ready.
